She wears a red halter-neck mini dress with a form-fitting tailored silhouette and a secure flattering V-neckline. Keep natural anatomy and realistic skin texture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 portrait with sharp focus on the adult woman's face and dress. She stands slightly angled toward the camera and makes a confident elegant hand gesture toward the lens, with a softly blurred foreground hand creating depth. Keep the background minimal and softly defocused.
